---
name: Phonetic / Pronunciation Correction
about: Report a pronunciation error or propose a new phonetic rule for Marathi or Sanskrit
title: '[PHONETIC] '
labels: ['phonetics', 'quality']
assignees: ''
---

**Language / Context**
- [ ] Modern Marathi
- [ ] Classical / Old Marathi
- [ ] Sanskrit (Stotra / Shloka)

**Input Word or Phrase (Devanagari)**
> Example: दुःख, निःशब्द, ॐ

**Current Pronunciation (What TTS speaks)**
Describe the incorrect pronunciation or phoneme sequence generated currently.

**Expected / Correct Pronunciation**
Describe how native speakers or traditional recitation pronounce it.

**Grammatical or Phonetic Rule Justification**
If applicable, describe the underlying rule (e.g. Visarga Sandhi, Schwa Deletion, Anusvara nasalization, conjunct expansion).

**Relevant Metre or Stotra (if applicable)**
If this occurred within a specific stotra or metre (e.g. Anushtup, Bhujangaprayat, Shardulavikridita).
